## Four Interconnected Pillars
1. **Financial Markets & Capital Markets:**
   - Internship at Anand Rathi International Ventures (IFSC) Pvt. Ltd. at GIFT City (May 2026 – July 2026).
   - Practical operational exposure to the India International Bullion Exchange (IIBX) ecosystem.
   - Operated alongside live trading terminals for order entry, market watch observation, and margin/risk monitoring.
   - Dematerialization of physical gold into electronic Bullion Depository Receipts (BDRs).
   - Institutional client onboarding (KYC, GST, IEC validation) for Qualified Jewellers.

2. **Quantitative Analysis & Trading:**
   - Engineered Market Sentiment Analyzer & Backtesting Engine using Python, Pandas, Matplotlib, and yFinance.
   - Built a 20/50 Simple Moving Average (SMA) crossover strategy tested on real NSE equities (INFY and TATAINVEST).
   - Calculated Compound Annual Growth Rate (CAGR), Sharpe Ratio, and Maximum Drawdown against Buy & Hold benchmarks.
   - Explored market friction realities: slippage, transaction costs, and whipsaw risks in consolidating regimes.

3. **Software Engineering & Full Stack:**
   - Full Stack Development Intern at Certopus Inc. (Remote, May 2026 – July 2026), building responsive UI and REST APIs.
   - Summer Trainee at Department of Atomic Energy, Heavy Water Plant Kota (July 2025), building internal PHP portal and studying industrial instrumentation and firewall setups.
   - Built custom Unix Shell in C implementing process forking (`fork`, `execvp`), pipes, and file redirection.

4. **Product Thinking & Development:**
   - Co-founded LawPrix (Triscaleon Technologies), an AI-assisted legal-tech platform routing users to verified lawyers based on practice domain and urgency rather than sponsored ad bidding.
   - 2nd Runner-Up at national Tutedude Buildathon 2025 for legal-tech SaaS sprint.
   - Created RegMate: GIFT City IFSC regulatory compliance reference and assessment system.

## Research Papers & Deep Dives
- [IIBX and India's Bullion Market](https://www.rakshitjain.in/research/iibx-and-indias-bullion-market): Comprehensive analysis of bullion dematerialization, Bullion Depository Receipts (BDRs), and GIFT City's IFSC exchange architecture.
- [20/50 SMA Strategy Backtesting](https://www.rakshitjain.in/research/sma-strategy-backtesting): Mathematical and programmatic evaluation of dual moving average crossover strategies, risk-adjusted metrics, and market frictions.
- [From Financial Workflows to FinTech Products](https://www.rakshitjain.in/research/financial-workflows-and-fintech-products): Operational bottlenecks in institutional onboarding and the engineering of deterministic "Compliance as Code."
